title: Restaurant Menu
intro: Benvenuto! My whole menu lives in my head. Can you help me put it up on the wall?
I wrote my dishes in your code, in a list called menu. Show every one, in that order, under “Marco's Kitchen”.
Put each price to the right of its dish. Nobody likes a surprise when the bill comes!
My sketch is up on the sign board. Press Run whenever you want me to take a look!
celebration: Bellissimo! Every dish, every price, all in a row.
thanks: Now the whole village knows what's cooking. Grazie mille!
request: Can you put my menu on the wall? Show "Marco's Kitchen" on top, then every dish from my menu list, in order, with its price to the right of it.

criteria.description: The text "Marco's Kitchen" is on screen
Every dish on the menu is on screen
criteria.message: My menu has four dishes, and every one of them belongs on the wall!

criteria.description: The dishes are in the menu's order, under "Marco's Kitchen"
Each price is to the right of its dish
criteria.message: My customers need to see what each dish costs.
